_provenance.note: windows are invented; activations are a numpy forward pass checked against each reference_policy.py

windows.name: Steady progress
events: run tests for the first time: 6 of 9 pass

windows.name: A retry that worked
events: run tests for the first time: all pass
re-run the tests: still all pass

windows.name: Same failure, five times
events: re-run the tests: 7 of 9 pass, as before

windows.name: Undo, redo, undo
events: re-run the tests: 7 of 9 pass, as before
switch to the other version again

l1.name: r1
l1.formula: r_s = relu(RI_s + RF_s + SR_s - NEU_s - 3*EXT_s) for slot s = unit + 1 (slots 1–7; slot 0 never repeats)  [this unit: s = 1]
l1.meaning: Redundant work in slot s: a repeated intent, a repeated identical failure and a state reversion each add one point.

l1.name: r2
l1.formula: r_s = relu(RI_s + RF_s + SR_s - NEU_s - 3*EXT_s) for slot s = unit + 1 (slots 1–7; slot 0 never repeats)  [this unit: s = 2]

l1.name: resA4
l1.formula: resA_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + EXT_s + VAL_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j + NEU_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 7 = slot 4 … unit 10 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 4]
l1.meaning: A successful repeat of an EXTERNAL call or of a non-comparable VALIDATE op in the last 4 events, after at least one earlier ERROR or NEUTRAL (poll) event in the window: a transient failure or a poll that came good.

l1.name: resA5
l1.formula: resA_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + EXT_s + VAL_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j + NEU_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 7 = slot 4 … unit 10 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 5]
l1.meaning: A successful repeat of an EXTERNAL call or of a non-comparable VALIDATE op in the last 4 events, after at least one earlier ERROR or NEUTRAL (poll) event in the window: a transient failure or a poll that came good.

l1.name: resA6
l1.formula: resA_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + EXT_s + VAL_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j + NEU_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 7 = slot 4 … unit 10 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 6]
l1.meaning: A successful repeat of an EXTERNAL call or of a non-comparable VALIDATE op in the last 4 events, after at least one earlier ERROR or NEUTRAL (poll) event in the window: a transient failure or a poll that came good.

l1.name: resA7
l1.formula: resA_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + EXT_s + VAL_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j + NEU_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 7 = slot 4 … unit 10 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 7]
l1.meaning: A successful repeat of an EXTERNAL call or of a non-comparable VALIDATE op in the last 4 events, after at least one earlier ERROR or NEUTRAL (poll) event in the window: a transient failure or a poll that came good.

l1.name: resB4
l1.formula: resB_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} RF_j) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7, bias −3  [this unit: s = 4]
l1.meaning: A comparable passing re-run in the last 4 events after at least one repeated identical failure earlier in the window: a retried validation failure that was repaired.

l1.name: resB5
l1.formula: resB_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} RF_j) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7, bias −3  [this unit: s = 5]
l1.meaning: A comparable passing re-run in the last 4 events after at least one repeated identical failure earlier in the window: a retried validation failure that was repaired.

l1.name: resB6
l1.formula: resB_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} RF_j) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7, bias −3  [this unit: s = 6]
l1.meaning: A comparable passing re-run in the last 4 events after at least one repeated identical failure earlier in the window: a retried validation failure that was repaired.

l1.name: resB7
l1.formula: resB_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} RF_j) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7, bias −3  [this unit: s = 7]
l1.meaning: A comparable passing re-run in the last 4 events after at least one repeated identical failure earlier in the window: a retried validation failure that was repaired.

l1.name: RT_a
l1.formula: RT_a = relu(sum_{s=4..7} RF_s)
l1.meaning: Repeated identical failures in the last 4 events.

l1.name: RT_b
l1.formula: RT_b = relu(sum_{s=4..7} RF_s - 1), bias −1
l1.meaning: Clip helper: layer 2 forms RT = RT_a - RT_b = [a recent repeated failure exists].

l1.name: NF
l1.formula: NF = relu(sum_s (ERR_s - VC_s) - 10 * sum_{s=4..7} VD_s)
l1.meaning: Fresh-failure evidence: non-comparable errors (a suite's first failing result, an external or tool error) minus comparable passing runs, plus 10× any recent regression, minus 10× any recent improvement.

l1.name: VM1
l1.formula: VM1 = relu(sum_s SR_s - 1), weight 1 on every SR, bias −1
l1.meaning: ≥ 1 iff at least two state reversions (N_rev = 2).

l1.name: PROG
l1.formula: PROG = relu(100 * sum_s VD_s - 1), weight 100 on every VD, bias −1
l1.meaning: ≥ 1 iff the net validation delta S >= 0.02.

l1.name: NZ
l1.formula: NZ = relu(-20 * sum_s VD_s - 1), weight −20 on every VD, bias −1
l1.meaning: ≥ 1 iff S <= -0.1 (a net regression: the tests are changing, so the window is not a stall).

l1.name: OOP
l1.formula: OOP = relu(sum_s RF_s - 3), weight 1 on every RF, bias −3
l1.meaning: ≥ 1 iff the window holds ≥ 4 repeated identical failures: retries beyond R_max = 3.

l1.name: POLL
l1.formula: POLL = relu(RI_7 + NEU_7 + EXT_7 - 2), bias −2
l1.meaning: The endpoint is a repeated NEUTRAL EXTERNAL operation (a poll in flight).

l1.name: OVER
l1.formula: OVER = relu(sum_s NEU_s + 3 * NEU_0 - 6), weight 1 on every NEU (4 on NEU_0), bias −6
l1.meaning: The poll run is beyond policy: 7 or more neutral events in the window, or the run already filled slot 0 (it started before the window) with 4 or more neutral events (P_max = 5).

l2.name: OSC
l2.meaning: OSCILLATING condition: ≥ 2 reversions.

l2.name: SA_a
l2.formula: SA_a = relu(R + 2*OOP - 1 - veto), R = u0 + … + u6 (weights 1 on units 0–6, 2 on unit 21, −40 on units 18, 19, 20, bias −1)
l2.meaning: Stall evidence: redundancy R >= 2, or retries beyond policy, with no change in validation results and fewer than two reversions.

l2.name: SA_b
l2.formula: SA_b = relu(R + 2*OOP - 2 - veto), same weights, bias −2
l2.meaning: Clip helper: STALL_A = SA_a - SA_b is 0/1.

l2.name: SB_a
l2.formula: SB_a = relu(2*POLL + OVER - 2 - veto) (weights 2 on unit 22, 1 on unit 23, −40 on units 18, 19, 20, bias −2)
l2.meaning: Over-polling stall: the endpoint poll belongs to a run beyond policy (or ≥ 3 units of OVER on their own).

l2.name: SB_b
l2.formula: SB_b = relu(2*POLL + OVER - 3 - veto), same weights, bias −3
l2.meaning: Clip helper: STALL_B = SB_a - SB_b is 0/1.

l2.name: ACT
l2.formula: ACT = relu(2*(RT_a - RT_b) + NF/32 - 2 - 10*OOP) (weights 2, −2 on units 15, 16; 1/32 on unit 17; −10 on unit 21; bias −2)
l2.meaning: Active in-policy episode: a recent repeated failure, fresh-failure evidence, and at most 3 repeated failures.

l2.name: RES_a
l2.meaning: Any resolution-like event (circuit B).

l2.name: RES_b
l2.meaning: Clip helper: RES = RES_a - RES_b is 0/1 (each resolution unit fires with value ≥ 1/8).

l2.name: POLLf
l2.formula: POLLf = relu(POLL - OVER) (weights 1 on unit 22, −1 on unit 23)
l2.meaning: In-flight polling that is still within policy.

l2.name: u9
l2.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: u10
l2.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: u11
l2.meaning: Unused.

out.name: PRODUCTIVE
out.meaning: The default branch: no loop condition holds, every logit is 0 and the first-index tie rule selects PRODUCTIVE.

out.name: RECOVERY
out.meaning: logit_recovery: RECOVERY iff an in-policy episode is active, or an episode resolved within the last 4 events, or polling is in flight within policy, and not OSCILLATING.

out.name: STALLED
out.meaning: logit_stalled: STALLED iff the stall evidence holds and no RECOVERY signal is present (spec 6.3 rule 3: no episode in policy at the endpoint) and not OSCILLATING.

out.name: OSCILLATING
out.meaning: logit_oscillating: OSCILLATING iff V >= 2. Highest precedence: it vetoes RECOVERY (−10000) and STALLED (−1000).

l1.name: ine0
l1.formula: ine_s = relu(RI_s + SR_s + RF_s - NEU_s), unit s reads slot s  [this unit: s = 0]
l1.meaning: Stall-ineffective score of event s: 1 per repeated intent, per state reversion and per repeated identical failure; a NEUTRAL-outcome repeat (poll, plan) scores 0.

l1.name: ine1
l1.formula: ine_s = relu(RI_s + SR_s + RF_s - NEU_s), unit s reads slot s  [this unit: s = 1]
l1.meaning: Stall-ineffective score of event s: 1 per repeated intent, per state reversion and per repeated identical failure; a NEUTRAL-outcome repeat (poll, plan) scores 0.

l1.name: ine6
l1.formula: ine_s = relu(RI_s + SR_s + RF_s - NEU_s), unit s reads slot s  [this unit: s = 6]
l1.meaning: Stall-ineffective score of event s: 1 per repeated intent, per state reversion and per repeated identical failure; a NEUTRAL-outcome repeat (poll, plan) scores 0.

l1.name: ine7
l1.formula: ine_s = relu(RI_s + SR_s + RF_s - NEU_s), unit s reads slot s  [this unit: s = 7]
l1.meaning: Stall-ineffective score of event s: 1 per repeated intent, per state reversion and per repeated identical failure; a NEUTRAL-outcome repeat (poll, plan) scores 0.

l1.name: end2
l1.formula: end2 = relu(RI_7 + SR_7 + RF_7 - NEU_7 - 1), bias −1
l1.meaning: Clip helper for the endpoint: layer 2 forms END = ine_7 - end2 = min(1, ine_7), i.e.

l1.name: ee4
l1.formula: ee_s = relu(ERR_s - VC_s) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 9 = slot 4 … unit 12 = slot 7)  [this unit: s = 4]
l1.meaning: Episode-like error in the last 4 events: an ERROR that is not a comparable test result (comparable failing test runs are task-level, not episodes).

l1.name: ee5
l1.formula: ee_s = relu(ERR_s - VC_s) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 9 = slot 4 … unit 12 = slot 7)  [this unit: s = 5]
l1.meaning: Episode-like error in the last 4 events: an ERROR that is not a comparable test result (comparable failing test runs are task-level, not episodes).

l1.name: ee6
l1.formula: ee_s = relu(ERR_s - VC_s) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 9 = slot 4 … unit 12 = slot 7)  [this unit: s = 6]
l1.meaning: Episode-like error in the last 4 events: an ERROR that is not a comparable test result (comparable failing test runs are task-level, not episodes).

l1.name: ee7
l1.formula: ee_s = relu(ERR_s - VC_s) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 9 = slot 4 … unit 12 = slot 7)  [this unit: s = 7]
l1.meaning: Episode-like error in the last 4 events: an ERROR that is not a comparable test result (comparable failing test runs are task-level, not episodes).

l1.name: rs4
l1.formula: rs_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + MUT_s + VAL_s + EXT_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j - VC_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 13 = slot 4 … unit 16 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 4]
l1.meaning: Resolution-like event in the last 4 events: a successful repeat of a MUTATE / VALIDATE / EXTERNAL operation that is not a comparable test result, preceded in the window by at least one episode-like error.

l1.name: rs5
l1.formula: rs_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + MUT_s + VAL_s + EXT_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j - VC_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 13 = slot 4 … unit 16 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 5]
l1.meaning: Resolution-like event in the last 4 events: a successful repeat of a MUTATE / VALIDATE / EXTERNAL operation that is not a comparable test result, preceded in the window by at least one episode-like error.

l1.name: rs6
l1.formula: rs_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + MUT_s + VAL_s + EXT_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j - VC_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 13 = slot 4 … unit 16 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 6]
l1.meaning: Resolution-like event in the last 4 events: a successful repeat of a MUTATE / VALIDATE / EXTERNAL operation that is not a comparable test result, preceded in the window by at least one episode-like error.

l1.name: rs7
l1.formula: rs_s = relu(RI_s + SUC_s + MUT_s + VAL_s + EXT_s - VC_s - 3 + (1/8) * sum_{j<s} (ERR_j - VC_j)) for s = 4, 5, 6, 7 (unit 13 = slot 4 … unit 16 = slot 7), bias −3  [this unit: s = 7]
l1.meaning: Resolution-like event in the last 4 events: a successful repeat of a MUTATE / VALIDATE / EXTERNAL operation that is not a comparable test result, preceded in the window by at least one episode-like error.

l1.name: Vm1
l1.formula: Vm1 = relu(sum_s SR_s - 1), weight 1 on every SR, bias −1
l1.meaning: ≥ 1 iff at least two state reversions in the window.

l1.name: Vm2
l1.formula: Vm2 = relu(sum_s SR_s - 2), bias −2
l1.meaning: Clip helper: layer 2 forms V2 = Vm1 - Vm2 = [V >= 2] (N_rev = 2).

l1.name: PROG_a
l1.formula: PROG_a = relu(1e4 * sum_s VD_s - 174), weight 10000 on every VD, bias −174
l1.meaning: Ramp that reaches 1 when the net validation delta over the window reaches 0.0175.

l1.name: PROG_b
l1.formula: PROG_b = relu(1e4 * sum_s VD_s - 175), bias −175
l1.meaning: Clip helper: PROG = PROG_a - PROG_b = [S >= 0.0175] (ramp over S in [0.0174, 0.0175]).

l1.name: OOP
l1.formula: OOP = relu(sum_s RF_s - 2 * EXT_7 - 3), weight 1 on every RF, −2 on EXT_7, bias −3
l1.meaning: Retries beyond policy: ≥ 1 iff the window holds ≥ 4 repeated identical failures (R_max = 3), or ≥ 6 when the endpoint is EXTERNAL (P_max = 5 polls).

l1.name: POLL
l1.formula: POLL = relu(RI_7 + NEU_7 + EXT_7 - 2), bias −2
l1.meaning: The endpoint is a repeated NEUTRAL EXTERNAL operation: in-flight polling of a dependency.

l1.name: u23
l1.formula: all zero (unused)
l1.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: OSC
l2.formula: OSC = relu((u17 - u18) - (u19 - u20)) = relu(V2 - PROG)
l2.meaning: OSCILLATING condition: ≥ 2 reversions and no net progress.

l2.name: STALL_a
l2.formula: STALL_a = relu(pre), pre = sum_{s} ine_s + 30*(ine_7 - end2) - 34 - 30*PROG - 30*V2 (weights: 1 on units 0–6, 31 on unit 7, −30 on unit 8, −30/+30 on units 19/20, −30/+30 on units 17/18, bias −34)
l2.meaning: ≥ 1 iff stall evidence C >= 5 (N_stall = 5) and the endpoint is stall-ineffective, vetoed (−30) by progress and by V >= 2.

l2.name: STALL_b
l2.meaning: Clip helper: STALL' = STALL_a - STALL_b is the 0/1 STALLED condition before the episode veto.

l2.name: ACT_a
l2.formula: ACT_a = relu(E - 10*OOP), E = u9 + u10 + u11 + u12
l2.meaning: Recent episode-like error with retries still within policy.

l2.name: ACT_b
l2.meaning: Clip helper: ACT = ACT_a - ACT_b = [E >= 1 and OOP = 0] — an in-policy episode is active at the endpoint.

l2.name: RES_a
l2.meaning: Any resolution-like event in the last 4 events.

l2.name: RES_b
l2.meaning: Clip helper: RES = RES_a - RES_b is the 0/1 "episode resolved within k_rec = 4" indicator.

l2.name: POLL
l2.meaning: Pass-through of the endpoint-poll detector.

l2.name: u8
l2.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: u9
l2.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: u10
l2.meaning: Unused.

l2.name: u11
l2.meaning: Unused.

out.name: PRODUCTIVE
out.meaning: The default branch (return 0): no loop condition holds, so every logit is 0 and the first-index tie rule selects PRODUCTIVE.

out.name: RECOVERY
out.meaning: logit_recovery in reference_policy: RECOVERY iff (ACT or RES or POLL) and not OSCILLATING and not STALLED. The +200 on ACT outweighs the −100 STALL' veto, so an active in-policy episode overrides the stall count (spec 6.3 rule 3: "no episode is in policy at the endpoint").

out.name: STALLED
out.meaning: logit_stalled: STALLED iff C >= 5, endpoint stall-ineffective, no progress, V < 2 and no active in-policy episode.

out.name: OSCILLATING
out.meaning: logit_oscillating: OSCILLATING iff V >= 2 and no net validation progress. Highest precedence: it vetoes RECOVERY (−1000) and STALL' (−30·V2 in layer 2).
